full_prompt_en: A square oil painting presents a tightly cropped half-length study of a bearded man against a nearly black background. His body turns toward the right, but his face is shown in left-facing profile, the gaze fixed beyond the picture's left edge. A broad rose-violet cloth wraps around his head in deep folds, with pale warm highlights running along its ridges. Beneath it, his forehead creases above a dark brow and a small alert eye. Warm light from the upper left shapes the prominent nose, cheek, ear, and fingers, while the far side of the neck and jaw falls into brown shadow. A dense reddish-brown beard extends from the cheek down toward the chest. His bent hand rises in front of the mouth, knuckles resting near the lips and chin; the forearm enters from the lower left. The gesture and faraway gaze make the still pose thoughtful. He wears a blue-green outer garment with broad, softly folded sleeves and a glimpse of pale inner fabric at the neck. The sleeve on the right catches cool silver-blue highlights and fills the lower-right corner, balancing the warm face and head cloth. The image has no visible setting or additional objects; dark negative space presses around the head and shoulder. Fine oil brushwork blends the lit flesh into subtle half-tones, while directional strokes make the textile folds more apparent. The black background absorbs detail without flattening the figure, and the contrast between lit upper forms and shadowed lower areas creates compact depth. The overall composition is intimate and contemplative, built from warm skin, rose cloth, cool blue fabric, and deep surrounding darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画在近黑背景前呈现一名留胡须男子的紧裁半身像。身体转向右侧，但面孔以朝左的侧面出现，目光固定在画面左缘之外。宽阔玫瑰紫色布料层层缠在头上，较浅的暖色高光沿褶脊运行。其下，额头在深眉之上皱起，一只小而警觉的眼睛望向远方。来自左上方的暖光塑出突出的鼻子、脸颊、耳朵和手指，颈部及下颌远侧则落入棕色阴影。浓密赤褐胡须从脸颊延到胸前。他弯起的手停在嘴前，指关节靠近嘴唇与下巴；前臂由左下进入。这个动作与远望的眼神让静止姿态显得沉思。他穿蓝绿色外衣，袖子宽阔而柔和折叠，领口露出一小块浅色内层布料。右侧衣袖接住冷银蓝色高光，填满右下角，与暖色面部和头巾平衡。图像没有可见场景或其他物件，深色负空间从头和肩周围逼近。细密油画笔法把受光肌肤融合为微妙半明度，方向性笔触则让织物褶皱更加明显。黑背景吸收细节，却没有压平人物；上部受光形体与下部阴影的对比形成紧凑纵深。整体构图亲密而沉思，由暖肌色、玫瑰色头巾、冷蓝布料与周围浓黑构成。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting relies on concentrated directional light against a broad almost-black field. Warm ocher and rose-violet occupy the principal lit masses, while deep umber and cool blue-green settle into lower and peripheral areas. Smooth blended half-tones turn rounded forms gradually; firmer, directional strokes describe folded surfaces and sharp raised edges. Dark contours are often created by value loss into the surrounding field rather than by drawn outlines. The brightest accents gather along a few upper ridges and small projecting planes, while the lower half remains compressed in shadow. The composition is close and compact, with one luminous central mass counterweighted by a cooler textured area. The background contains almost no distracting detail, allowing the material contrast between softly modeled paint and visible fabric-like strokes to stand out. The overall effect is solemn and intimate, its depth carried by chiaroscuro and restrained color rather than by an elaborate setting.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅油画依靠集中的定向光与大片近黑底面形成对照。暖赭色和玫瑰紫占据主要受光团块，深棕和冷蓝绿沉在下部与外围。平滑融合的半明度让圆润形体缓慢转折；较坚实、有方向的笔触描绘折叠表面与凸起锐边。深色轮廓常由明度消失于周围色域而形成，而不是额外描线。最亮的重音聚在少数上方脊线和细小前凸平面，下半部则压缩在阴影中。构图紧凑而贴近，一个发光中央团块由较冷的有肌理区域平衡。背景几乎没有分散注意力的细节，使柔和塑形颜料与可见织物般笔痕之间的材质对照更突出。整体效果庄严而亲密，纵深由明暗对照和克制色彩承担，而非复杂场景。
theme_en: A bearded man in a rose turban resting his hand against his mouth
theme_zh: 戴玫瑰色头巾的胡须男子以手抵住嘴边
name: Sebastiano del Piombo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
